text: 长飞光纤公告，预计上半年净利润约为人民币24.00亿元到人民币30.00亿元，同比增长711%到914%。报告期内，得益于算力数据中心的加速建设，国内外新型光纤光缆产品需求持续增长，行业供需结构不断改善。公司充分利用全球领先的行业地位，紧抓国际市场机遇，大力拓展算力数据中心相关业务，实现了核心客户的拓展、产品结构的优化及盈利能力的提升，公司经营业绩同比增长。
text_en: Yangtze Optical Fibre announces that it expects net profit for the first half of the year to be approximately 2.400 billion yuan to 3.000 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 711% to 914%. During the reporting period, driven by accelerated construction of computing data centers, demand for new types of optical fiber and cable products continued to grow both domestically and internationally, improving industry supply-demand dynamics. The company leveraged its globally leading position, seized international market opportunities, and expanded computing data center-related businesses, achieving core customer expansion, product structure optimization, and profitability improvement, with operating results up year-on-year.
